x: Francis Skelley, now recovered from his accident and stationed somewhere in Kent, and would like to hear from some of his old Club friends. " Quack," out in " the States," still has time to write to England and sends a ponderous sports programme more like a general store catalogue.

Dereck equalled the Club junior record for the high jump with a height of 5'8" at the Club championships, he also won the senior long jump with a distance of 21'11" beating the existing Junior record of 21'6½" held by F.
